title: Candlestick chart
intent: Show daily open, high, low, and close values with a full-range wick and direction-colored body.

ai.create: Create a responsive candlestick chart from Observable's AAPL rows using the raw Date, Open, High, Low, and Close fields.
ai.maintain: Change the selected trading window while preserving all 60 interval segments, raw AAPL field names, date identity, and typed endpoint channels.
